source: Structured transcription of the owner-reported native tool schema; not an independently exported native schema; no monitor started

command.semantics: Shell source; each stdout line event; exit ends watch

output: No synchronous return schema. Asynchronous machine notifications, not user replies, per line/frame. show_lines true gives FEED transcript cells. Timed ceiling30min. Stop via muse.work_stop/source ends/session ends. Persistent has no deadline until these stops.
